status: Conceptual bias-field options, not a qualified magnet lifetime or electromagnet design

permanent.scope: Cold model values near the outlet, not manufacturer-rated air-gap measurements.
permanent.consumable: No normal consumption by applying the solder-current pulse; energy is supplied electrically. Irreversible loss can occur if temperature/opposing-field operating point is outside the selected grade demagnetization curve.

stock_example.limits: Catalogue claim does not qualify this hot air-gap assembly, coatings, attachments or lifetime.

electromagnet_ideal_gap.method: Ampere-law ideal high-permeability return path: NI=B_gap*g/mu0. Fringing, core reluctance, saturation and local pole geometry omitted.
electromagnet_ideal_gap.scope: One illustrative winding for scale only; a current regulator from24V would be needed. No manufactured coil/yoke layout, thermal design or loaded field solution. SteadyDCbias, separate from50kHzinduction actuation.

tradeoffs: Permanent magnets are compact and need no bias power; use a hot-qualified grade and measure the assembled field.
Electromagnet gives tunable field but adds continuous heat and bulk. A rough1.2kA-turn scale does not demonstrate actual pole field or jetting.
The solder-current pulse still needs its own controlled200A-class path; the bias coil is not a replacement for that current.
